look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Inspect the glossy, stiff leaves with sharply prickly margins and the rounded ear-like leaf bases clasping the stem. Broken stems release milky latex. Flower heads are yellow and composed of strap-shaped florets; compare the softer, less-prickly leaves and more pointed clasping auricles of Sonchus oleraceus.
